class_contracts.name: Quarantine compromised endpoints
class_contracts.independent_postcondition: selected hosts isolated; management and unselected hosts still reachable

class_contracts.name: Block communicating endpoint pairs
class_contracts.prerequisite: selected and control endpoint pairs reachable
class_contracts.independent_postcondition: selected pairs blocked; control pairs unchanged

class_contracts.name: Permit communicating endpoint pairs
class_contracts.independent_postcondition: selected pairs reachable; unrelated policies preserved

class_contracts.name: Rate-limit selected services
class_contracts.prerequisite: meter/queue capability confirmed; isolated throughput workload
class_contracts.independent_postcondition: measured selected throughput capped; control flows unaffected
class_contracts.inverse_cleanup: restore owned meters/queues and flow references

class_contracts.name: Raise bandwidth or priority
class_contracts.prerequisite: predeclared bottleneck and competing traffic; queue support confirmed

class_contracts.name: Reroute demands away from a resource
class_contracts.prerequisite: alternate paths verified and resource named
class_contracts.independent_postcondition: independent path evidence avoids resource; reachability retained

class_contracts.name: Restore default paths
class_contracts.prerequisite: owned detours installed and defaults recorded

class_contracts.name: Create isolated tenant slices
class_contracts.prerequisite: unused tenant/VLAN identifiers; endpoint membership defined

class_contracts.name: Resize tenant slices
class_contracts.prerequisite: owned slices exist; resource budget and resize meaning frozen

class_contracts.name: Delete tenant slices
class_contracts.independent_postcondition: selected slices removed; unselected slices unaffected

class_contracts.name: Onboard tenant services
class_contracts.prerequisite: isolated service endpoints and tenant bindings provisioned
class_contracts.independent_postcondition: tenant can access intended service; other tenants blocked
class_contracts.inverse_cleanup: remove owned service registrations and forwarding

class_contracts.name: Withdraw tenant services
class_contracts.independent_postcondition: selected services unavailable to intended tenant; others unchanged

class_contracts.name: Redirect selected flows
class_contracts.prerequisite: redirect destination and return path provisioned
class_contracts.independent_postcondition: independent path/service evidence plus correct return delivery

class_contracts.name: Audit selected policies once
class_contracts.prerequisite: explicit policy IDs and expected compliant/noncompliant states
class_contracts.independent_postcondition: audit agrees with independent state snapshot; no mutation
